releases.notes: 回归套件分层：默认 smoke 只验应用自身，依赖环境的断言原样搬进点名套件（device/live/negative），真机上照跑不打折。原来两类断言混在一条套件里，在模拟器上永远不可能绿，红灯也就失去了信号价值。

localizedNotes.en: Split the regression suites: the default smoke suite now covers only app-side behaviour, while environment-dependent assertions move verbatim into named suites (device/live/negative) that still run on real hardware.

releases.notes: 迁到 TS 构建管线 + @aibox/applet-sdk：桥胶水统一（confirm 不可用一律回 false、openURL 超时封顶、图片走 applet:// 代理），运行形态改为构建型（端上不再转译）。

localizedNotes.en: Migrated to the TS build pipeline and @aibox/applet-sdk; bridge glue unified and the runtime is now prebuilt (no on-device transpile).

releases.notes: 子页栈改用框架资产 aibox/ui 的 useSubpageStack（删除本地 lib/subpages.js 副本）

localizedNotes.en: Subpage stack now uses the framework's useSubpageStack from aibox/ui (local copy removed)

releases.notes: 新增 .tests.json 回归套件（覆盖指数行情与板块页）

localizedNotes.en: Add a .tests.json regression suite covering index quotes and the sector page

releases.notes: 子页导航改用系统原生页栈：标的详情左滑返回时实时透出上一页、可中途放弃，不再直接退出整个小应用；到价提醒入口移进详情页动作行（顶栏交给宿主画）；tabs.changed 现在消费 rendered。

localizedNotes.en: Subpages now mirror into the host's native page stack: swiping back from an instrument detail reveals the previous page live and can be abandoned mid-drag, instead of dismissing the whole applet. The price-alert entry moved into the detail action row now that the host draws the navigation bar, and tabs.changed now consumes rendered.

releases.notes: 首个版本：1:1 复刻原生理财模块
